name: Subohmega
look: a heavy brushed-steel mechanical falcon with glowing cherry-red coils in its chest, steel feather wings and talons
entry: A heavy, industrial-grade mechanical falcon constructed from brushed stainless steel and glowing resistance coils. Its chest glows cherry-red before it unleashes colossal, storm-sized plumes of electrified vapor.
how: Use a Thunder Stone on Modwing. It learns Flash Cannon when it evolves.
Wild: rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
